# /etc/nginx/desyn/local (host-specific, generated by bootstrap.sh)

These files differ per server and are never overwritten by later deploys. The copies here are examples with
documentation-range values, used by `deploy/scripts/lint.sh` to run `nginx -t`.

| File | Content | Written by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth-switch.conf` | `$desyn_prelaunch` (1 = basic auth on, 0 = launched) | bootstrap.sh, `basic-auth.sh on/off` |
| `gate.conf` | random gate token (`$desyn_gate_token`, `$desyn_gate_cookie_ok`), mode 0600 | bootstrap.sh |
| `trusted.geo` | 127.0.0.1, ::1, the desyn_net subnet, this host's public IPs | bootstrap.sh |
| `listen-80.conf`, `listen-443.conf` | listen lines matching the host (IPv6, http2 style for the nginx version) | bootstrap.sh |
| `brotli.conf` | brotli directives when the module is loaded, otherwise a comment | bootstrap.sh |
| `resolver.conf` | `resolver` (the host's nameservers) for the `/api/v1` + `/mcp` proxy to the Convex Cloud site URL | bootstrap.sh (added on re-run to older installs) |
